Accomplishment
1. Professor Emeritus of Univ. of Colorado at Boulder since 1973

2. Curator Emeritus of Zoology, Univ. of Colorado Museum, Univ. of Colorado at Boulder (科羅拉多大學波德博物館動物館館長) 1973-1999

3. President of North America Taiwanese Professors' Association (北美洲台灣人教授協會會長) 1992-1993

4. Founding president of Taiwanese Association of Colorado (科羅拉多州台灣同鄉會創會會長) 1976, 1991, 1992

5. Principal on Taiwanese School for Taiwanese Association of Colorado, Denver (設立科州台灣學校) 1986

6. Coordinator of the 3rd Plains Fall Conference at Estes Park, Colorado (平原區夏令會召集人) 1987

7. President of FAPA-Colorado Chapter, 2011-2012

8. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 07/2018
